title: Descent of divided powers along a surjective ring map
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative rings, $q:A\twoheadrightarrow B$ a surjective unital ring map, and $J\subseteq A$ an ideal with an ordinary divided-power structure $\theta$ [def-sfb-ordinary-divided-power-structure]. Assume $\theta_n(x)\in\ker(q)\cap J$ for all $x\in\ker(q)\cap J$ and $n\geq1$. Then the ideal $q(J)\subseteq B$ has a unique ordinary divided-power structure $\bar\theta$ satisfying $\bar\theta_n(q(x))=q(\theta_n(x))$ for all $x\in J$ and $n\geq1$.

source.place: Tag 07H2 (lemma-kernel), part (2), implication (a) to (b); stated directly for an arbitrary surjective ring map.
